cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/moddable && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('xs/sources/xsLexical.c')
text=p.read_text()
old='''                case '&':
                        p = fxGetNextEntity(parser, p, q);
                        break;
'''
new='''                case '&':
                        if (p < q)
                                p = fxGetNextEntity(parser, p, q);
                        else
                                fxReportParserError(parser, parser->line, "invalid character %d", parser->character);
                        break;
'''
if old not in text: raise SystemExit('old not found')
p.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1))
PY

old not found
